summary: Updated sync-personas.js to strip AUTO-GENERATED comment header before frontmatter parsing (two locations)
Ran build and verified all 7 persona files generated cleanly
Documented round-trip diff: only intentional changes (AUTO-GENERATED header, code-fence indentation, mcp-tools-note placement, detect-step wording)

comments.note: serializeTools() uses YAML single-quote array format (['vscode', ...]) instead of JSON.stringify — required for round-trip fidelity with original persona files. Documented as intentional deviation.

Partial indentation cannot be auto-carried through text substitution; handoff code fences are at column 0 in generated output vs 3-4 space indent in originals. Acceptable: the indented style was cosmetic only and the content is identical.
sync-personas.js header-stripping logic is duplicated in two functions (extractVSFileName, validateLedgerFrontmatter). Could be extracted to a shared helper in a future cleanup pass.
